_approach: A continuous 16th shaker shaped like a sidechain release (dips right after the kick, swells back up by the next hit, mirroring the ~230ms release nu-disco producers dial into their shaker sends) drives the groove under a punchy kick and offbeat open hats. MPC swing 54% (engine 0.08), the tightest disco-house pattern in the set. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
